files.extraction: Unmodified class/function bodies plus local descriptive header and standard-library imports only.

adapter_corrections_and_boundaries: Independent discovery calls no legacy analyze_history, PR85, existing target rejection, external CLI, provider or order path.
Only completed as-of bars are consumed; latest trigger is excluded from VCP base, volume baselines and prior pivots.
VCP uses the raw source pivot at the donor contraction index, not the donor rounded display price. ZigZag evidence uses only its completed prior prefix, not future source values.
Stockbee uses donor trigger and consolidation primitives, but no risk-distance, sizing, stop, market score or 3-to-5-day exit template.

PEAD is explicitly a locally authored verified earnings-event gap plus daily consolidation follow-through hypothesis, not an unchanged copy of the donor weekly red-candle strategy, not EPS surprise, and not verified performance.
Trend Pullback/Reclaim and Relative Strength Leader are locally authored small setup/trigger adapters, not claimed external profitable implementations.
Default configurations are transparent untuned research hypotheses. Scores are evidence descriptions, not return probabilities or proven optimal weights.
All discovered candidates still require original shared Technical/data, News/AI, confidence, RR, budget/exposure, paper execution and TP/SL gates. No existing order or position is modified.
